summary: Six new sources span five languages and six platforms; disagreements concern character depth, slow narrative, recognition versus availability, and unresolved historical truth. Failed generic Reddit region thread and blocked Babelio not counted.
next: Add scholarly and regional criticism to complement this reader-focused batch.

sources.title: En busca del tiempo perdido: comentarios y opiniones
sources.note: Readers praise patient, immersive prose and Charlus while others abandon the opening or find it tedious without denying its reputation; enjoyment and attributed merit diverge.
sources.limits: Small self-selected set; early abandonment is not a whole-work evaluation; ratings not normalized.

targets.A: Distinct international reception or textual interpretation.

sources.title: Lalka: opinie
sources.note: Displayed readers disagree directly: one finds characters didactic and one-dimensional on rereading, another praises multilayered psychology and the anatomy of nineteenth-century Warsaw.
sources.limits: Edition-specific page; other editions may pool reviews and must not become extra underlying sources.

sources.title: Overlooked non-anglophone literature
sources.note: Readers distinguish Nobel recognition from local availability; recommend Jahnn’s imagery, Chang Kuei-hsing’s family violence and Bonomini’s individual/collective tensions.
sources.limits: Availability claims are anecdotal and require verification; translated and untranslated works distinguished.

sources.title: Un chef d’oeuvre paradoxal
sources.note: Coriolano relates fascination and boredom to the novel’s manipulation of time, detached narrator and irony; recommends cautiously because thin action can deter readers.
sources.limits: Review-index excerpt and standalone text count together, not twice; one reader’s experience.
